observation: Recursive main Git tree is complete (truncated=false), providing tracked path/blob SHA/size manifest.
Canvas text creation mutates Zettelkasten text before obtaining the spatial text-node projection.
Keyboard movement applies a movement angle/force into node dynamics from the frame loop.
Selected nodes scale by factors 1.04/0.96 around the selected-node centroid.
Connecting two text nodes adds bidirectional Zettelkasten references rather than directly adding only a physical edge.
Connecting non-text nodes creates an Edge and registers it with endpoints and Graph.
Text-edge direction/removal can mutate Zettelkasten references, coupling visual edge operations to semantic note relations.
Text-node deletion routes through the Zettelkasten parser while generic deletion removes graph/projection/incident-edge state.
GraphsKeeper persists graph data/meta and blob data/meta in separate LocalForage stores and export combines JSON metadata with raw blobs.
Persistent browser state is concentrated in LocalForage Stored instances plus localStorage key families; provider credentials are stored in localStorage in legacy code.
DirectAccess resolves caller-supplied paths and can enumerate/read any path available to the Node process.
Local sidecar orchestrator can execute npm install and dynamically import service modules into one Node process.
Automation service launches Playwright browser and exposes base64 screenshot output over HTTP.
Text-node Python execution dynamically imports Pyodide 0.23.0, loads packages and calls runPythonAsync.
Web code is bundled from node content/connected nodes and assigned to iframe srcdoc including script content.
AI node assembles connected/search/history context, streams provider inference, supports abort/regenerate and can propagate to connected AI nodes.
AI message-loop control syntax can create memory notes, rewrite text and disconnect relationships.
AIProxy exposes provider inference plus granular Ollama list/pull/delete/create/show/blob/push operations.
Neural API builds a function registry with aliases and exposes discoverable operations but legacy function-call execution ultimately invokes functions directly.
Electron branch is a distinct complete source specimen pinned to its own commit/tree.
Electron downloads frontend/server release ZIPs and desktop installers; source does not explicitly verify asset digest/signature before extraction/spawn.
Static source evidence cannot establish actual visual/timing/failure/offline/persistence behavior; runtime and golden fixtures remain open.
